Investigation of $n=pq$ where $p$ and $q$ are distinct primes.

$g(pq) + pq = pg(q) + qg(p)$

$g(pq) + pq = p(q+1) + q(p+1) = pq + p + pq + q = 2pq + p + q$
3. Deriving $g(pq)$:
$g(pq) = 2pq + p + q - pq = pq + p + q$.

$pq + p + q = 2pq$
$p + q = pq$
$pq - p - q = 0$
$(p - 1)(q - 1) = 1$

6. Conclusion: There are no solutions for $n=pq$ where $p \neq q$.
